title: Tatos Forever
description: This project is a modpack designed for a group of friends that go by the 'Tatos'. This will be the pack to join a server hosting our forever world which will be updated with a core group of mods we like to play with.
body:
# 🥔 Tatos Forever – The Ultimate Vanilla+ Modpack for Friends

Tatos Forever is a carefully crafted Vanilla+ modpack made specifically for a group of friends known as the Tatos — but built in a way that anyone can enjoy. It’s designed to bring friends together through creativity, engineering, exploration, and a shared Minecraft world that feels alive, smooth, and personal.

The purpose of the pack is to add as little terrain changing mods as possible that still add content that feel like it fits the Vanilla aesthetic. Since this is designed to be a forever pack everything has to stay as stable as possible for as long as possible. Even though there is not much for content mods it is still a divergence from vanilla that feels unique and fun.

## ⚙️ Built for the Tatos (and Friends Like Them)

This modpack is designed around:

Collaborative builds

Shared survival worlds

Long-term progression

Fun, not frustration

It emphasizes mods that encourage teamwork, creativity, and emergent gameplay rather than grind or complexity overload.

## 🛠️ Engineering & Automation

At its core is Create, delivering satisfying mechanical systems for factories, transport, and automation that feel both powerful and intuitive. Perfect for group projects and megabases.

## 🌱 Farming, Food & Living Worlds

With Farmer’s Delight Refabricated and Animal Feeding Trough, agriculture becomes deeper, more visual, and more rewarding — ideal for players who want to specialize as farmers, chefs, or homestead builders within the group.

## 🏡 Decoration & Personal Expression

Make the world unmistakably yours with:

Beautify Refabricated for cozy décor

Mo Glass for stylish builds

Signed Paintings and Scribble for artwork, signs, and inside jokes that only the Tatos would understand

## ⚔️ Combat & Exploration

With Better Tridents, YDM’s Weapon Master, Elytra Physics, and Veinminer, exploration and combat feel smoother, more dynamic, and more fun — whether you’re adventuring solo or in a group.

## 📦 Quality of Life for Group Play

Subtle but powerful improvements keep gameplay flowing:

Shulker Box Tooltips, Trade Cycling, Visible Traders

Gravestones to avoid rage-quit moments

Carry On, Mouse Tweaks, Fast Item Frames, and more

## 👥 Multiplayer at Its Best

With Simple Voice Chat, proximity chat adds a whole new layer to your group experience — whether you’re coordinating builds or yelling for help in a cave.

## 🚀 Performance & Visuals

Powered by Sodium, Lithium, Bobby, and Iris Shaders, Tatos Forever runs smoothly and looks stunning without demanding high-end hardware.

## ✨ Why Tatos Forever?

✔ Built for friends
✔ Vanilla-friendly
✔ Performance-optimized
✔ Cozy + industrial aesthetics
✔ Encourages collaboration
✔ Perfect for long-term worlds

Tatos Forever isn’t just a modpack — it’s a shared world for a group of friends to grow, build, and laugh in together.
